title: US bag fees vs worldwide airline ancillary revenue, 2023
notes: In 2023, US airlines collected $7.1B in checked-bag fees alone (BTS). The same year, airlines worldwide collected $117.9B in total ancillary revenue (seat selection, bags, loyalty program sales, and other extras), per IdeaWorksCompany/CarTrawler's annual estimate -- bags are roughly one-sixteenth of the total add-on business.
